questions.question: The first battle of Tarain was fought between ___________.

options.text: Prithviraj Chauhan and Mohammad Bin Qasim

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Prithviraj Chauhan and Muhammad Ghori**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The first battle of Tarain** was fought in 1191 CE near Thanesar, present-day Haryana.
 
• Prithviraj Chauhan was the king of Ajmer and Delhi, and Muhammad Ghori was the ruler of Ghurids in Afghanistan.
 
• The battle was fought between the Ghurids and the Chauhans over the control of the northwestern regions of India.
 
• The Chauhan army was led by Prithviraj Chauhan, while the Ghurid army was led by Muhammad Ghori himself.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Mohammad Bin Qasim was an Arab general who invaded Sindh in 712 CE, nearly 500 years before the first battle of Tarain. Hence, this option is incorrect.
 
• Mahmud Ghaznavi was a Turkish ruler who invaded India multiple times in the 11th century, but he did not participate in the first battle of Tarain. Hence, this option is incorrect.
 
• Qutubuddin Aibak was a slave-general of Muhammad Ghori who later became the first Sultan of Delhi after Ghori's death. He did not participate in the first battle of Tarain as he was not yet a prominent figure. Hence, this option is incorrect.

questions.question: The process in which metals are extracted from their ores by heating beyond the melting point is called __________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Smelting**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Smelting** is a process in which metals are extracted from their ores by heating beyond their melting point. During this process, the metal is separated from its impurities and a pure form of metal is obtained.
 
• Smelting is commonly used for extracting metals such as iron, copper, lead, and zinc from their ores. It is an important process in the metallurgical industry.
 
• Spinning is a process of twisting fibers together to make yarn or thread. It is not related to the extraction of metals from their ores.
 
• Heaving is not a process used in the extraction of metals from their ores. It is a term used to describe the upward movement of soil or rocks due to frost or ice.
 
• Extracting is a general term used for any process of separating a substance from its mixture or compound. It can refer to the extraction of metals, oil, or any other substance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Smelting is a highly energy-intensive process and requires a high temperature to melt the metal. The process can produce a lot of air pollution and greenhouse gases.
 
• Spinning is a process commonly used in the textile industry to make fabrics and clothing. It involves twisting fibers together to create a yarn or thread, which is then woven into fabric.
 
• Heaving is a geological process that occurs due to the expansion of soil or rocks when they freeze. The expansion can cause the soil or rocks to move upward, which can lead to landslides or other geological hazards.
 
• Extracting can refer to the extraction of any substance from its mixture or compound. For example, oil can be extracted from the ground using drilling and pumping techniques.

questions.question: Which among the following vitamins influences iron absorption?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Vitamin C**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vitamin C** influences iron absorption **by increasing the solubility of iron** in** the stomach and enhancing** its absorption in the small intestine.
 
• Vitamin C also helps in the conversion of ferric iron to ferrous iron, which is more easily absorbed by the body.
 
• Vitamin C-rich foods include citrus fruits, strawberries, kiwi, tomatoes, and bell peppers.
 
• Iron absorption may be reduced by consuming foods or supplements high in calcium, tannins, or phytates.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• Iron is an essential mineral required for the production of hemoglobin, a protein in red blood cells that carries oxygen throughout the body.
 
• Iron deficiency can lead to anemia, fatigue, weakness, and impaired immune function.
 
• Good dietary sources of iron include red meat, poultry, fish, beans, lentils, spinach, and fortified cereals.
 
• Vitamin B: While B vitamins play a role in energy metabolism and red blood cell production, they do not directly influence iron absorption.
 
• Vitamin D: Vitamin D is important for calcium absorption and bone health, but it does not affect iron absorption.
 
• Vitamin K: Vitamin K is necessary for blood clotting and bone health, but it does not impact iron absorption.

questions.question: The Medical Termination of Pregnancy (MTP) Amendment Act, 2021 increases the upper limit for termination from 20 to __________ weeks for certain categories of women.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**24**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Medical Termination of Pregnancy (MTP) Amendment Act, 2021** was passed by the Parliament of India on **March 17, 2021**.
 
• This amendment increases the upper limit for termination of pregnancy from 20 weeks to 24 weeks for certain categories of women, including rape survivors, victims of incest, and other vulnerable women such as differently-abled women and minors.
 
• This amendment was made to address the difficulties faced by women who were unable to access safe and legal abortions due to the earlier restrictive provisions of the MTP Act.
 
• The 22-week option mentioned in the question is incorrect as the upper limit has been increased to 24 weeks. The other options, 26 weeks, 28 weeks, and blank, are also incorrect.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• The MTP Act was first enacted in India in 1971 and was amended in 1975 and 2002.
 
• The earlier version of the MTP Act allowed termination of pregnancy only up to 12 weeks and required the opinion of two doctors for termination between 12 to 20 weeks.
 
• The 2002 amendment increased the upper limit for termination to 20 weeks and allowed termination up to 24 weeks in case of certain medical conditions.
 
• The 2021 amendment further relaxed the provisions of the MTP Act and increased the upper limit for termination to 24 weeks for certain categories of women.
 
• The MTP Act also provides for the establishment of registered abortion clinics and the training of medical professionals in safe and legal abortion practices.

questions.question: Where is the deepest point on earth, the Mariana Trench, located?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Pacific Ocean**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Mariana Trench,** which is the deepest point on earth, is located in the **Pacific Ocean**.
 
• It is situated in the western Pacific Ocean, to the east of the Mariana Islands.
 
• The Mariana Trench is approximately 2,550 km long and 69 km wide, with a depth of 10,994 meters at its deepest point, known as the Challenger Deep.
 
• The trench is formed by the collision of the Pacific Plate and the Philippine Plate, which creates a subduction zone and leads to the formation of the deepest part of the ocean floor.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 

 
• **Atlantic Ocean - **

 
 
• This is incorrect because the Atlantic Ocean, while vast and home to significant depths, does not contain the deepest point on Earth.
 
• Its deepest point is the Milwaukee Deep (Puerto Rico Trench), which is approximately 8,376 meters (27,480 feet) deep, far shallower compared to the Mariana Trench.
 
 
 
• **Indian Ocean -**
 
 
• This option is not correct. The Indian Ocean's deepest point is the Java Trench (also known as the Sunda Trench), with a maximum depth of about 7,725 meters (25,344 feet), making it much shallower than the Mariana Trench.
 
 
 
• **Arctic Ocean -**
 
 
• This is also incorrect. The Arctic Ocean's deepest point is the Molloy Deep in the Fram Strait, with a depth of about 5,550 meters (18,209 feet).
 
• While fascinating for its own ecological and geographical characteristics, it does not compare to the depth of the Mariana Trench.
 
 

 

Thus, the Mariana Trench's extreme depth and unique ecosystem have made it a subject of much scientific research and interest, emphasizing its significance located in the Pacific Ocean.

questions.question: The Standard Meridian of India (82°30′ E) passes through __________ state of India.
questions.solution:
**The correct answer is:** "Madhya Pradesh"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Importance of Standard Meridian:**

 
 
• The Standard Meridian of India, 82°30′ E, is used to calculate Indian Standard Time (IST).
 
• It helps maintain a uniform time standard across the country, despite India's wide longitudinal span.
 
 
 
• **Passes through Madhya Pradesh:**
 
 
• The Standard Meridian passes through several states, but Madhya Pradesh is a key state it crosses, near the city of Mirzapur.
 
• This longitudinal line is important for maintaining IST throughout India, ensuring synchronization of time zones across regions.
 
 
 
• **Why 82°30′ E was chosen:**
 
 
• India spans longitudes from 68°7′ E to 97°25′ E, and 82°30′ E was selected as the standard because it is almost central to this span, minimizing time differences across regions.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Standard Time Zones:**

 
 
• Many countries adopt standard meridians to calculate their local time. India uses 82°30′ E, similar to how other nations designate their own meridians.
 
• This ensures uniformity in official timekeeping and avoids confusion caused by varying local times in different parts of the country.
 
 
 
• **Other States:**
 
 
• Although the Standard Meridian passes through other states like Uttar Pradesh and Chhattisgarh, it is prominently associated with Madhya Pradesh.
 
• The choice of a central location for the meridian helps balance time differences across India's east and west, making Madhya Pradesh a geographically important state for timekeeping.

• The Legislative Council is also known as the Vidhan Parishad in some states.
 
• The main function of the Legislative Council is to act as a check on the powers of the Legislative Assembly.
 
• The Legislative Council is a permanent house, unlike the Legislative Assembly, which is subject to dissolution.
 
• Currently, only seven states in India have a Legislative Council - Andhra Pradesh, Bihar, Jammu and Kashmir, Karnataka, Maharashtra, Telangana, and Uttar Pradesh.

questions.question: In the situation of liquidity trap, the speculative money demand function becomes __________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**infinitely elastic**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **A liquidity trap** occurs when interest rates are so low that monetary policy becomes ineffective in stimulating economic growth.
 
• In such a situation, the speculative money demand function becomes** infinitely elastic** because people prefer to hold cash rather than invest in assets that offer low returns.
 
• This means that even if the central bank increases the money supply, it will not lead to an increase in investment or consumption because people will simply hoard the extra cash.
 
• Therefore, fiscal policy, such as government spending or tax cuts, may be more effective in boosting demand and stimulating economic activity.
 
• Option 1, unitary elastic, is incorrect because it implies that a small change in interest rates would lead to an equal change in the demand for money. This is not the case in a liquidity trap where people are indifferent to changes in interest rates.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Inelastic money demand function means that people are willing to hold a fixed amount of money regardless of changes in interest rates or income levels.
 
• Zero money demand function means that people do not want to hold any money and prefer to invest all their wealth in other assets. This is an extreme case and not relevant in practice.
 
• Infinitely elastic money demand function means that people are willing to hold any amount of money at a given interest rate. This is the case in a liquidity trap where people are willing to hold cash even at zero interest rates.

questions.question: The Rampurva bull that was part of a Mauryan pillar found in Rampurwa, Bihar is now been placed at __________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Rashtrapati Bhavan**__.

• **The Rampurva bull** is a significant artifact of the Mauryan period, and it was discovered as part of a pillar in **Rampurva, Bihar**.
 
• The bull is made of polished sandstone and is believed to have been created during the reign of Emperor Ashoka.
 
• In the present day, the Rampurva bull is housed in the Rashtrapati Bhavan, which is the official residence of the President of India.
 
• The Rashtrapati Bhavan is located in New Delhi and was designed by Sir Edwin Lutyens, who was also responsible for designing several other iconic landmarks in the city.

• **Sansad: **This refers to the Indian Parliament, which is located in the Sansad Bhavan complex in New Delhi.
 
• **Rajpath: **This is a ceremonial boulevard in New Delhi that connects the Rashtrapati Bhavan to India Gate and is often used for parades and processions.

questions.question: In which country was the ICC Cricket World Cup (Women's) 2022, held?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**New Zealand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The ICC Cricket World Cup (Women's) 2022 **was held in** New Zealand**.
 
• This was the 12th edition of the tournament and the fourth time it was held in New Zealand.
 
• The tournament was initially scheduled to be held in February-March 2021, but was postponed due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
 
• The tournament featured eight teams - Australia, England, India, New Zealand, Pakistan, South Africa, Sri Lanka, and West Indies.
 
• New Zealand won the tournament by defeating Australia in the final.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **England **has hosted the ICC Cricket World Cup (Men's) five times - in 1975, 1979, 1983, 1999, and 2019. The Women's World Cup has been held in England twice - in 1973 and 1993.
 
• **Australia **has hosted the ICC Cricket World Cup (Men's) five times - in 1987, 1992, 2015, 2020 (co-hosted with New Zealand), and 2023 (upcoming). The Women's World Cup has been held in Australia twice - in 1988 and 2009.
 
• **India **has hosted the ICC Cricket World Cup (Men's) three times - in 1987, 1996, and 2011. The Women's World Cup has been held in India once - in 2013.
